headline:
Your Holiday Party,
On the Water
subhead: A private boat on Lake Travis — the whole vessel is yours, crew included.

lede.title: Cozy inside, lake all around.
lede.body: In winter our flagship gets partially enclosed with heaters and a fire pit on the bow, so your team celebrates in comfort no matter the temperature. Austin Decembers are generally gorgeous — but the evenings can get chilly.

includes.title: Every booking includes
items: The whole boat, private to your group
Heaters, winter enclosure, bow fire pit
Full sound system — bring your playlist

makeItYours.title: Make it yours
makeItYours.body: Cruise the lake, stay dockside and mingle, or do half and half — same price either way. Bring the caterer you love. Decorate it however you like.

gettingThere.title: Easy to get to
gettingThere.body: Anderson Mill Marina, 13993 FM 2769, Leander, TX 78641 — about 30 minutes from downtown. We'll arrange a shuttle so nobody has to drive.

partnerCallout.title: Free bar consultation & drink delivery
partnerCallout.body: Our partner Party On Delivery plans your bar with you and delivers straight to the dock — no venue markup, free delivery to the marina, and unopened bottles come back for a refund.

estimate.title: Party Details & Estimate
estimate.sub: One flat price for the boat, plus estimates for food and drinks.

rows.label: Saturday — December 12 or 19
rows.note: Captain, crew, heaters, enclosure, sound, coolers and ice all included

food.title: Food — three ideas
food.tag: Est. for 35 · or bring your own

rows.label: Rudy's Bar-B-Q
rows.note: Three meats, three sides, linens and serving ware included

rows.label: La Pera
rows.note: Upscale Latin-inspired platters and boxed service

rows.label: The Board Bae ATX
rows.note: A styled grazing table — great for mingling

rows.label: Estimate for cocktails, wine and beer
rows.note: Delivered to the dock. Free bar consultation included — you pick exactly what your team likes, at retail prices. Free delivery to the marina, and unopened items can be returned.

rows.label: Live DJ
rows.inline: our house DJ, set up and ready when you board

rows.label: Event photographer
rows.inline: aboard all evening, edited photos delivered after

total.label: For 35 guests
total.note: Saturday boat + food + drinks, depending on the caterer you choose.

weather.title: If the weather turns
weather.body: We check the forecast together 48 hours out. Below 40°F or too windy, we reschedule — one free rain date within 12 months, deposit carried over.

questions.title: Questions?
questions.body: Call or email anytime — happy to hold a date while you decide.
